''See also: [[Copper sight Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Copper]] sight is a foundational level of perception used by those at the [[Copper stage]] of progression. It allows an individual to perceive the world through the lens of [[aura]], making various elemental and spiritual energies visible as distinct colors and patterns. For example, [[wind]] may appear as vivid green, [[earth aura]] can look like glowing yellow lightning or concentrated golden cubes, and Life aura{{!}}life aura may manifest as green lines within a person's body. This sight also enables the user to observe [[madra channels]], see the flow of vital energy between heaven and earth, and detect specific types of [[aura]] such as dream, fire, or [[destruction]]. Beyond mere observation, the [[Copper stage]] provides the ability to begin [[cycling]] [[aura]] and converting it into [[madra]]. While highly useful for identifying threats or understanding environmental energies, the sight can be overwhelming in areas with extremely high concentrations of power.}}

== Underlord ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|[[Copper]] sight is a sensory ability that allows the user to perceive ribbons of color representing life, earth, and [[wind]]. While the sight can be opened, doing so causes physical pain within the [[Night Wheel Valley]]. During [[Lindon]]'s journey, the [[aura]] in this valley proved too strong for him to open the sight. However, when viewed through this ability, the Emperor's [[aura]] appeared as a burning pale green.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|[[Lindon]] uses [[Copper sight]] to see ribbons of color representing [[wind]], earth, and life.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c6">''Underlord'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|[[Copper sight]] can be opened but causes pain in the [[Night Wheel Valley]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c10">''Underlord'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|[[Lindon]] did not open his [[Copper sight]] because the [[aura]] was too strong.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c12">''Underlord'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|In [[Lindon]]'s [[Copper sight]], the Emperor's [[aura]] burned a pale green.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c17">''Underlord'', chapter 17</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|[[Copper sight]] is a sensory ability.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c18">''Underlord'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
